# metactl

> A human-first, agent-safe CLI for composing, projecting, and validating agent instruction surfaces.

## Start here

- [Agent surfaces](docs/agent-surfaces.md) — target-owned files and machine-output contract.
- [Skill discovery](docs/user/skill-discovery.md) — saved preferences, project enrollment, routing receipts and provider boundaries.
- `metactl explain --capabilities --json` — command, error, and target capability manifest; works outside a project.
- `metactl help --all` — complete local command help.

## Porcelain commands

- `metactl setup` — plan or create a metactl project.
- `metactl use <pack>` — resolve, add, and sync a pack.
- `metactl sync --preview` — inspect generated changes without applying them.
- `metactl status` — show readiness, drift, and next actions.
- `metactl validate` — check generated surfaces and policy.
- `metactl doctor` — run health checks.
- `metactl --project PATH skills preferences` — inspect effective discovery preferences without changing consent or enrollment.
- `metactl --project PATH skills doctor --target TARGET --use-preferences --json` — inspect one client's discovery registration, local health and observed events without a provider call.
- `metactl demo` — create or remove a disposable sandbox.

## Agent contract

- Use `--agent` for machine-readable JSON and non-interactive operation.
- Every `--agent` failure includes `ok: false`, API version, command, error code, and recovery `next_commands`.
- `next_commands` is always a non-empty array; consumers can safely offer recovery actions.
- Machine lists may be bounded; inspect `<list>_truncated` and `<list>_total_count`, or pass `--full`.
- Pass `--project PATH` to target a project explicitly; `explain --capabilities` needs no project.
- For relevant specialist instructions, call `discover_skills`, then load a returned ID and digest. Report its routing receipt; registration alone does not prove discovery or Jev use. Do not change consent or enroll projects without authorization.
